chapter: Old New Orleans bands and Buddy Bolden
title: Tio and Dublade's band and early dance music before jazz
summary: Tony Dublade, a violinist, was Tio's godfather and with his father led the Creole Tio and Dublade band, which played waltzes and quadrilles; Tio says jazz came about his time and credits Buddy Bolden with the first jazz number.
